notes: Single source of truth for SCAMWISE heuristics. Patterns are case-insensitive JavaScript/Dart-compatible regular expressions. Weights add up to a 0-100 score.

text_rules.label: Asks for an OTP, PIN, password or banking credentials
text_rules.advice: Legitimate banks, apps and government services never ask you to share an OTP, PIN, CVV or password.

text_rules.label: Creates urgency or a short deadline
text_rules.advice: Scammers rush you so you don't stop to check. Pause and verify through an official channel.
patterns: \b(urgent(ly)?|immediately|right now|act now|asap|without delay|today itself|turant|abhi ke abhi)\b

text_rules.label: Threatens to block, suspend or disconnect an account or service
text_rules.advice: Threats of immediate suspension are a classic pressure tactic. Check your account by opening the official app yourself.

text_rules.label: Requests a payment, fee or money transfer
text_rules.advice: Be wary of unexpected requests to pay fees, 'refundable' deposits, or to approve a UPI collect request.
patterns: \b(collect request|approve (the )?(upi )?(request|payment)|enter (your )?upi pin to receive|scan (the |this )?qr( code)? to (receive|get|claim))\b

text_rules.label: Claims to be a bank, government body, courier or well-known company
text_rules.advice: Contact the organisation through its official app, website or the number printed on your card, not the one in the message.
patterns: \b(sbi|state bank|hdfc|icici|axis bank|kotak|pnb|bank of baroda|canara|yes bank|paytm|phonepe|google ?pay|gpay|bhim|npci|amazon|flipkart|rbi|reserve bank|income ?tax|it department|epfo|uidai|aadhaar (centre|department)|trai|dot|cbi|cyber ?cell|police|customs|fedex|dhl|blue ?dart|india ?post|delhivery|bescom|msedcl|tata power|adani electricity|netflix|whatsapp support|microsoft support|apple support)\b[^\n]{0,80}\b(verify|update|kyc|block|suspend|refund|reward|click|link|confirm|deactivat|pending|failed|seized|parcel|bill)

text_rules.label: Pushes an urgent KYC / PAN / Aadhaar update
text_rules.advice: KYC updates are done in-branch or inside the official app, never through a link in an SMS.

text_rules.label: Promises a prize, lottery, cashback or reward
text_rules.advice: You cannot win a lottery you never entered. Unexpected rewards are bait.

text_rules.label: Uses police, court or 'digital arrest' threats
text_rules.advice: Indian police and agencies do not conduct 'digital arrests' over video calls or demand payment to close a case. Call 1930.
patterns: \b(digital arrest|arrest warrant|legal action|police case|fir (has been|is) (filed|registered)|court notice|money laundering|narcotics|drugs (were )?found|parcel (has been )?seized|non-?bailable)\b

text_rules.label: Asks you to install an app or share your screen
text_rules.advice: Screen-sharing and unknown APKs give scammers control of your phone. Only install apps from the Play Store.

text_rules.label: Offers easy money, part-time tasks or work-from-home earnings
text_rules.advice: 'Like videos and earn' and task-based jobs usually end with you paying a deposit you never get back.

text_rules.label: Tells you to keep it secret from family or your bank
text_rules.advice: Being told not to tell anyone is a strong sign of a scam. Talk to someone you trust.

text_rules.label: Asks for an OTP or PIN in Hindi/Hinglish
text_rules.advice: Bank staff and legitimate support teams should never ask you to share an OTP, UPI PIN, CVV or password. Never share it.

text_rules.label: Uses urgent Hindi/Hinglish pressure language
text_rules.advice: Scammers create panic to stop you checking. Pause and verify through the official app or phone number.
patterns: \b(abhi ke abhi|turant|jaldi karo|der mat karo|aaj hi|warna account band|account band ho jayega|sim band ho jayega)\b

text_rules.label: Pressures you to send money in Hindi/Hinglish
text_rules.advice: Do not transfer money to unlock a job, prize, parcel or account. Verify independently first.
patterns: \b(paise bhejo|payment karo|paisa transfer karo|upi karo|fee jama karo|refundable deposit|pehle paise do)\b

auth_code.label: Message contains what looks like an OTP / authentication code (redacted)
auth_code.advice: Never forward or read out this code to anyone, including someone claiming to be from your bank. SCAMWISE removed it before sending anything to the server.
auth_code.keywords: (otp|one[- ]?time (password|passcode|code|pin)|verification code|security code|auth(entication)? code|login code|confirmation code|passcode|2fa code|code is|pin is|m-?pin|upi ?pin)
auth_code.exclude_before: (pin ?code|pincode|postal code|zip code|promo code|coupon code|order( no| number| id)?|ref(erence)?( no)?|a/c|account( no)?|ending|xx+)
